verdict.rationale: Gladia documents choosing a transcription model via a `model` request parameter, with `solaria-1` as the default, and its pricing page lists per-model rates (0.27€/hr Solaria-1 vs 0.16€/hr Solaria-3), so model choice and cost tradeoffs are covered. The evidence contains no published accuracy figures (e.g. WER) or latency figures per model; the blind-vote comparison tool is not published accuracy data. Missing for 10: published per-model accuracy metrics, published per-model latency figures, a fuller documented model comparison, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose among documented transcription models with published accuracy, latency, and cost tradeoffs

citations.quote: Pick a model with `model` in your request. Omit it to use the default: **`solaria-1`**.
Default generalist. 100+ languages, async and live, code switching.
0.27€/hr Solaria-1 / 0.16€/hr Solaria-3 at 0-100 hours per month, falling by tier
